card.name: Opening parenthesis before a percentage
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or first digits of a percentage written after a count such as 3/355 patients. It appears in clinical-trial results comparing adverse event rates between treatment groups.

modes.label: Parenthesis after patient count
modes.description: The "(" that opens a percentage right after a patient count in a drug-versus-comparator comparison.

modes.label: Digits inside a percentage
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a percentage that follows a fraction of patients.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a percentage is about to be given after a patient count in trial results.
